title: Anthropic's IPO caps explosive growth period for AI startup, filled with contradictions
summary: Today, the company that dedicated itself to prioritising safety, building the Claude chatbot along the way, has been one of the loudest voices raising warnings about how the same technology could bring catastrophe. It's one of the contradictions that mark the brief, colourful history of Anthropic, which emerged Thursday from its first day of trading on Wall Street with a market value of $1.75 trillion.
llm_summary: Anthropic, the AI startup behind the safety‑focused Claude chatbot, went public on Thursday with a market valuation of about $1.75 trillion. The company has long warned that powerful AI could pose existential risks, making its IPO—a sign of massive commercial success—a striking contrast to its cautionary stance. This paradox highlights the tension between rapid growth in the AI sector and the push for responsible development.
